fixed_settings.angular_rule: n_mu=q, n_phi=2q; hold energy order at L3
fixed_settings.energy_rule: 2*q_E Gauss nodes per edge-split panel; hold angular order at L3
fixed_settings.point_comparison: same histories, point*solid_angle versus integrated angular/energy L3

interval_method: two-sided Bonferroni normal/delta; diagnostic eligibility required
membership_rule: Union of prior v3 headline members across arms; cone always retained
scale_rule: Prior v3 PyRITE discrete transport / continuous cone pooled mean; common to all arms

bounds.termination: first slab exit or electron cutoff

cone.stage: source: photons at creation, unit transmission

seed_policy.pairing: independent unless primary IDs, zero scores and substreams are verified
seed_policy.submission_blocker: Freeze collision-checked per-shard map before submission
